model_name_taken: A model named {{model}} already exists. Choose another name or edit the existing model.
vendor_name_taken: A vendor named {{vendor}} already exists. Choose another name or edit the existing vendor.
prefill_group_name_taken: A prefill group named {{name}} already exists. Choose another name.
model_sync_not_configured: Model metadata sync is not set up on this server. Set the metadata endpoint URLs in the server environment and restart it.
model_sync_source_unavailable: The {{source}} catalog could not be read, so nothing was synced. Try again later.
lane_not_found: Lane {{lane}} does not exist. Refresh to see the current lanes.
lane_builtin_locked: Lane {{lane}} is built in, so it cannot be stopped or deleted.
lane_ever_enabled: Lane {{lane}} has carried traffic before, so it cannot be deleted. Stop it instead.
lane_has_no_sources: Lane {{lane}} has no sources yet; enabling it would drop every request sent to it. Move a source into it first.
lane_in_use: Lane {{lane}} still has sources, prices or discounts. Move or remove them before deleting the lane.
tier_not_found: Tier {{tier}} does not exist. Refresh to see the current tiers.
tier_exists: A tier named {{tier}} already exists. Choose another name or edit that tier.
tier_builtin_locked: Tier {{tier}} is built in, so it cannot be deleted.
tier_has_accounts: Tier {{tier}} still has accounts in it. Move them to another tier on the Users page, then delete it.
sell_price_missing: No sell price was entered. Enter at least one price before saving.
sell_price_model_listed: {{model}} is still listed, so its price cannot be removed. Unlist the model first.
sell_price_model_served: Enabled channels still serve {{model}}; without a price its requests would be refused. Disable those channels first.
sell_price_model_discounted: {{model}} still has an active discount. Remove the discount before removing the price.
model_listing_unpriced: These models have no sell price on any lane and would be billed at $0: {{models}}. Set a price before listing them.
model_listing_no_source: These models have no enabled source on lane {{lane}}: {{models}}. Add a source before listing them.
